body:
Research report for #929 (`mcp, script and cli become a crate above app`).

## 1. Open questions and evidence

### Q1. What code and third-party dependencies move out of `camcraft-app`?
Move 43 files (`7,538` lines total) out of `crates/app/src/`.
These files are `crates/app/src/mcp/` (37 files, `6,078` lines), `crates/app/src/script/` (3 files, `924` lines), `crates/app/src/cli.rs` (`297` lines), `crates/app/src/bin/camcraft-cli.rs` (`8` lines), and `crates/app/src/raster.rs` (`231` lines).
`crates/app/src/raster.rs` serves only `crates/app/src/mcp/render.rs`, so it belongs with `mcp`.
Moving `script/` and `raster.rs` removes `boa_engine` and `png` from `crates/app/Cargo.toml`.
`boa_engine` (`Cargo.toml:42`) runs only in `crates/app/src/script/mod.rs:36` and `crates/app/src/cli.rs:175`.
`png` (`Cargo.toml:88`) runs only in `crates/app/src/raster.rs:223-225` and `crates/app/tests/mcp_render.rs:100,104` (per the MCP 2025-06-18 Tool Result image block and RFC 4648 section 4).
No other module inside `crates/app/src/` imports `crate::mcp`, `crate::script`, `crate::cli`, or `crate::raster`.

### Q2. What crate name and `Cargo.toml` dependencies fit the workspace rules?
Name the directory `crates/cli` and package `camcraft-cli` (with `[lib]` `camcraft_cli` and `[[bin]]` `camcraft-cli`).
`xtask/src/plan.rs:60` derives every package name as `camcraft-{dir}`.
This layout matches `crates/ui`, which builds package `camcraft-ui` and binary `camcraft-ui`.
(`crates/mcp` / `camcraft-mcp` is an alternative if you prefer MCP in the crate name.)
`crates/cli/Cargo.toml` needs `camcraft-app`, `flecs_ecs`, `serde_json`, `tracing`, `boa_engine`, and `png` from `[workspace.dependencies]`.
Keep `crates/app/src/clock.rs` (`pub mod clock`) and `crates/app/src/logging.rs` (`pub mod logging`) in `camcraft-app`, and call `camcraft_app::clock::Instant` and `camcraft_app::logging::init` from `crates/cli`.
Import `holder_library`, `lathe_holder`, `lathe_insert_zone`, and `spun` through `camcraft_app` (`crates/app/src/lib.rs:135,142,150`) instead of adding a new direct dependency on `camcraft-tools` (`crates/app/src/mcp/body_tools.rs:20-21` and `crates/app/src/mcp/holders.rs:15-16`).

### Q3. What `pub(crate)` items inside `crates/app/src/` must become `pub`?
Promote two `pub(crate)` seams in `crates/app/src/` to `pub`:
- `outward_normal` in `crates/app/src/pick/align.rs:147` (used by `crates/app/src/mcp/features.rs:17`).
- `Planned` and `plan_program` in `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs:228,277` (used by `crates/app/src/mcp/render.rs:209`).
All fields on `Planned` are already `pub`.
Every other module in `crates/app/src/` that `mcp`, `script`, or `cli` calls is already `pub mod` in `crates/app/src/lib.rs` (only `posting_family` at `lib.rs:55` is private, and none of the three modules uses it).

### Q4. How do `crates/ui` and the `wasm32` build keep live MCP?
Five files in `crates/ui` call `camcraft_app::mcp`:
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs:1608` (`Inbox`)
- `crates/ui/src/mcp_host.rs:17` (`answer_live`, `LiveAnswer`)
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs:322` (`port_from`, compiled on native and `wasm32-unknown-unknown`)
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_window.rs:49,52` (`Wake`, `Inbox::listen`)
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/mcp_live.rs:9` (`Inbox`, `Request`)

For the first crate split, add `camcraft-cli` to `crates/ui/Cargo.toml` and write a `docs/decisions/` entry.
This edge carries six items (`Inbox`, `Request`, `Wake`, `port_from`, `answer_live`, `LiveAnswer`), which meets the five-item threshold in `AGENTS.md`.
`camcraft-ui` stays above `camcraft-cli`, `--mcp-port` keeps working in `crates/ui`, and `camcraft-app` still sits below both.
If UI rebuild time or `wasm32` binary size matters later, pass a live-line callback from `crates/ui/src/main.rs` into the `ui` library in a separate change.

### Q5. What happens to the 54 test files in `crates/app/tests/` that touch `mcp`, `script`, or `cli`?
Thirty-five files (`34` integration test binaries) test only MCP, scripts, or the CLI: `cli.rs`, `scripting.rs`, `sinker_electrode_mcp.rs`, `mcp.rs`, `mcp_open/mod.rs`, and `30` `mcp_*.rs` files.
Move all 35 files to `crates/cli/tests/`.
Copy the small `revolve` mesh helper from `crates/app/tests/common/bore.rs` into `crates/cli/tests/mcp.rs` instead of sharing test helpers across crates.
Point `mcp_edit_machine.rs:55`, `mcp_wire_contour.rs:25`, and `sinker_electrode_mcp.rs:19` to `crates/app/tests/edm/` (`../../app/tests/edm/`), because non-MCP suites in `crates/app/tests/` also use `tests/edm/`.
`mcp_tool_body.rs:57` (`../../testdata/models`) and `scripting.rs:243` (`../../assets/scripts/cam.d.ts`) still resolve from `crates/cli/tests/`.
Update the path comment in `assets/scripts/cam.d.ts:3-5` (`crates/cli/src/script/mod.rs` and `crates/cli/tests/scripting.rs`).

Nineteen domain test files in `crates/app/tests/` also use `mcp::Server` or `script::refusal_text`:
- `2` pure MCP repros: `bore_facet_sagitta.rs`, `contour_arc_sim.rs`.
- `17` mixed domain files with `1` to `2` `Server::new()` or `refusal_text` checks: `box_pick.rs`, `circle_centre.rs`, `lathe_work_spindle.rs`, `model_fidelity.rs`, `refusal_ghost.rs`, `sinker_burn.rs`, `sinker_orbit.rs`, `sinker_side.rs`, `sinker_undersize.rs`, `sinker_wear.rs`, `step_budget.rs`, `step_chord_units.rs`, `tool_cutter_params.rs`, `tool_cutter_profile.rs`, `tool_cutting_rows.rs`, `tool_library_holders.rs`, `wall_column_gouge.rs`.
`camcraft-app` cannot add an upward `[dev-dependencies]` edge to `camcraft-cli` (`AGENTS.md`: "A test lives with the code it tests").
Split the MCP and `script::refusal_text` test functions out before moving `mcp`, `script`, and `cli`.

### Q6. What build, gate, wasm32, release, skill, and doc files must update?
- `Cargo.toml`: add `"crates/cli"` to `[workspace] members` and `camcraft-cli = { path = "crates/cli" }` to `[workspace.dependencies]`.
- `xtask/src/plan.rs:19-25`: add `"cli"` to `BATCH_CRATES`, `ALL_CRATES`, and `CLIPPY`.
- `xtask/src/gate_maps_tests.rs:85-89`: add `"mcp"`, `"script"`, `"cli"`, and `"raster"` to `moved`.
- `crates/app/tests/post_not_judged.rs:11`, `tool_import_modes.rs:9`, and `regression_models.rs:13`: remove stale `app::script` and `app::cli` tokens from Gate map comments.
- `xtask/src/release_pack.rs:57`: add `"camcraft-cli"` to `PRODUCT`.
- `web/build-app-wasm.sh:104-110`: build `-p camcraft-app --lib` and `-p camcraft-cli` for `wasm32-unknown-unknown` so `camcraft-cli.wasm` still links.
- `.github/workflows/release.yml:55,101,102,133,218`: build `-p camcraft-cli` alongside `camcraft-ui` and `camcraft-post`. (Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, Snap, Flatpak, and AppImage packaging scripts copy the `camcraft-cli` executable by name and need no edit.)
- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:13,14,61,198`: update paths from `crates/app/src/` to `crates/cli/src/`.
- `aur/PKGBUILD:30`, `README.md:93,118`, `site/content/guide/install.md:61`, `site/content/developers/crates.md:18`, `site/content/developers/commands.md:46`, and `docs/MACHINE-ONBOARDING.md:79`: update crate names and source paths to `crates/cli` / `camcraft-cli`.

---

## 2. Design proposal (smallest useful first slice first)

Run the extraction in three ordered slices so every PR builds cleanly and keeps `cargo xtask gate` green.

1. **First slice (unblock `crates/app/tests/`):** Extract the `mcp::Server` and `script::refusal_text` test cases out of the 17 mixed domain test files in `crates/app/tests/` into dedicated `mcp_*` or `script_*` test files inside `crates/app/tests/`. Rename or mark `bore_facet_sagitta.rs` and `contour_arc_sim.rs` so they move cleanly with MCP later. Remove stale `app::script` and `app::cli` names from `post_not_judged.rs`, `tool_import_modes.rs`, and `regression_models.rs`. Do not change source crates in this slice.
2. **Second slice (create `crates/cli` and move the modules):** Promote `outward_normal` and `stock_sim::{Planned, plan_program}` to `pub` in `crates/app`. Create `crates/cli` (`camcraft-cli`) with `mcp`, `script`, `cli`, `raster`, `src/main.rs`, and the moved MCP, script, and CLI test files. Remove `boa_engine` and `png` from `crates/app/Cargo.toml`. Point `crates/ui` at `camcraft_cli::mcp` and add a `docs/decisions/` entry. Update `xtask/src/plan.rs`, `xtask/src/gate_maps_tests.rs`, `xtask/src/release_pack.rs`, `web/build-app-wasm.sh`, `assets/scripts/cam.d.ts`, `.github/workflows/release.yml`, and `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` so gates, wasm builds, and releases pass.
3. **Third slice (packaging recipe and developer docs):** Update `aur/PKGBUILD`, `README.md`, `site/content/`, and `docs/MACHINE-ONBOARDING.md` to match `crates/cli` and `camcraft-cli`.
4. **Optional later slice (decouple `ui` from `boa_engine` and `png`):** Inject the live MCP handler from `crates/ui/src/main.rs` into the `ui` library if UI compile times or `wasm32` size become a concern.

---

## 3. Proposed sub-issues (not filed; waiting for maintainer approval)

1. **Extract MCP and script tests out of mixed domain suites in `crates/app/tests/`**
   - Move `Server::new()` and `script::refusal_text` checks out of the 17 mixed domain test files into dedicated files inside `crates/app/tests/`. Remove stale Gate map entries.
   - Done means: Only dedicated MCP, script, or CLI test files in `crates/app/tests/` import `camcraft_app::{mcp, script, cli}` or run `camcraft-cli`. `cargo xtask gate batch` passes.
   - Proposed priority: `P6` · Effort: `effort:medium` · Area: `area:mcp`, `area:build`

2. **Move `mcp`, `script`, `cli`, and `raster` into `crates/cli` (`camcraft-cli`)**
   - Create `crates/cli` (`camcraft-cli`) with `mcp`, `script`, `cli`, `raster`, and their test suites. Remove `boa_engine` and `png` from `crates/app`. Update `crates/ui` (with a `docs/decisions/` entry), `xtask`, `web/build-app-wasm.sh`, `.github/workflows/release.yml`, `assets/scripts/cam.d.ts`, and `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`.
   - Done means: `camcraft-app` does not contain `mcp`, `script`, `cli`, `raster`, `boa_engine`, or `png`. `cargo xtask gate batch`, `web/build-app-wasm.sh`, and `cargo build -p camcraft-cli` pass. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` points to `crates/cli/src/`.
   - Proposed priority: `P6` · Effort: `effort:high` · Area: `area:build`, `area:mcp`

3. **Update `aur/PKGBUILD` and developer documentation for `crates/cli` (`camcraft-cli`)**
   - Update `aur/PKGBUILD`, `README.md`, `site/content/guide/install.md`, `site/content/developers/crates.md`, `site/content/developers/commands.md`, and `docs/MACHINE-ONBOARDING.md` to use `crates/cli` and `-p camcraft-cli`.
   - Done means: Every build command, crate table entry, and source path in docs and `aur/PKGBUILD` matches `crates/cli` and `camcraft-cli`.
   - Proposed priority: `P6` · Effort: `effort:low` · Area: `area:build`, `area:mcp`

4. **(Optional) Decouple `crates/ui` library and `wasm32` shell from `camcraft-cli`**
   - Pass a live MCP handler callback from `crates/ui/src/main.rs`. Remove `camcraft-cli`, `boa_engine`, and `png` from the `crates/ui` library and the `wasm32` UI build.
   - Done means: `crates/ui/Cargo.toml` drops `camcraft-cli` from its library dependencies, or moves live MCP setup to binary startup. Edits to `mcp` do not rebuild the `crates/ui` library or the `wasm32` UI build.
   - Proposed priority: `P8` · Effort: `effort:medium` · Area: `area:ui`, `area:mcp`
Claim released (stale): the pool agent that claimed this issue ended without a PR, and no worker runs it now. Findings that it posted above stay valid. The issue is free again.
